name: sc-skills
description: A Seurat-first core pipeline of 8 Claude Code skills for single-cell RNA-seq analysis — CellBender/decontX preprocessing (sc-preprocessing), Harmony/scVI integration (sc-integration), and marker-verified annotation (sc-annotation), with R-first publication figures (scientific-plotting) under a shared house-conventions and reproducibility contract (sc-conventions, scientific-reproducibility). The single-cell skill orchestrates routing, and sc-paper-distill grows the suite from the literature by turning papers + code into provenance-tracked digests that promote reusable recipes back into the skills. A deliberately minimal backbone; opinionated (Seurat / R-first); portable SKILL.md format.
